title: Companion Data, Protocols and Code for Choosing Load Forecasting Methods by Horizon, History and Hour: Reserve and Imbalance Evidence from Four Grids
note: Zenodo dataset record, version 1.0. Companion package for a paper of the same name: four load series (Jordan 2015, Tetouan 2017, Panama 2015-2020, Spain 2015-2020), rolling-origin forecasts at horizons of 1 to 180 days plus hourly day-ahead, online combination and selection by horizon and by hour, conformal intervals, reserve and imbalance measures, MCS, Diebold-Mariano and aSPA tests.
